basic_info.description: A true single-family home nestled in the heart of the Inner Richmond. A light-filled, 3 story home with a perfect blend of modern convenience & traditional charm. Enter a large foyer & spacious living rm facing west with a wood-burning. Straight ahead a large dining rm & a contiguous family rm open to the kitchen. The kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, gas cook top & oven, dishwasher, refrigerator & plenty of counter space with an additional sink for preparing meals. Also a built-in bench with a table for informal eating. Glass doors open to an east facing deck & large garden. A staircase leads down to a lower level home office, a fifth bedrm or guest rm, as well as a third full bathrm. It has a private side entrance & opens to the garden. Four generously sized bedrms upstairs, the primary bedrm with luxurious ensuite bath overlooking the back yard. A full bathrm in the hall services the other 3 bedrooms. The tranquil backyard with a patio area. A 2 car garage & lots of storage space. The home features recently refinished hardwood floors, painted inside & out & a new roof in 2022. Located 2 blocks from Golden Gate Park, local shops, & restaurants, this home is the perfect balance of city living and suburban serenity. Don't miss your opportunity to own this fantastic gem.
